interview.name: Vik
interview.answer: This Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center on Maple Street.

reflections: Vik and Eli are coordinating a small volunteer repair effort and favor concise, action-oriented check-ins.
Jules is stepping in as a practical organizer, offering to connect people and close coordination gaps.
The group values clear ownership for logistics like volunteers, tool drop-off, and start time, with simple follow-up after lunch.
Vik is the main coordinator and keeps the repair drive moving by repeatedly spreading the word and checking in.
Jules is taking on concrete coordination work, especially volunteers and logistics, and is asking for clear outstanding tasks.
Ira is lower-involvement but supportive, staying informed while running errands and planning to follow up after lunch.
Vik is the main coordinator for the repair drive, repeatedly offering to spread the word and check back after lunch.
Jules and Ira are focused on logistics and follow-up, with Jules handling drop-off details and Ira monitoring updates while running errands.
The group communicates cooperatively and politely, with people acknowledging help, sharing responsibilities, and aligning on a common check-in time.
Vik is consistently driving the repair drive through repeated outreach and follow-ups, suggesting a proactive coordination role.
Uli is in a responsive relay position, waiting for new details and promising to pass them along or check back later.
Dane appears willing to support the effort, offering to catch up after lunch and help with remaining needs.
Vik is consistently the coordinator, reinforcing the repair drive and setting follow-up timing.
Quinn is handling broader outreach and logistics, including the event details and invites.
Uli and Cleo are supportive contributors who track incoming information and supplies, then report back later.
